recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6912 unless PA chooses to make a new broader editorial request about profiling constraints.
issue_request: FHIR-6912 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification PA issue requesting that Encounter.episodeOfCare change from 0..1 to 0..*, with additional notes about overlapping EpisodesOfCare referencing common encounters and an updated UML diagram.
initial_application: The explicit historical application is git commit 06c7ab85137432aeaa608312554b0f2f73e0dd7c, "Tracker# 6912, 7303, 7304, 7654 Ballot recon", which changed the old Encounter spreadsheet from 0..1 to 0..* and expanded the episodeOfCare definition. Later source-format rewrites preserved that applied content in the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: FHIR-7098 is a duplicate of the same 2015May Encounter/EpisodeOfCare ballot request and includes a PA comment supporting 0..* on Encounter because EpisodeOfCare is ongoing and usually created before encounters. Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, current source and generated/current artifacts are consistent, and no relevant Zulip or Confluence records were found that alter the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current authoritative source and diagram already satisfy the substantive request; adding a generic note that profiling can constrain the element would be redundant with normal FHIR profiling behavior.
